## Architectural Thesis
The Scar Architecture Ecosystem replaces monolithic dense weight matrices and linear O(T) KV Cache growth with directional vector quantization + low-rank residual scars (**Mixture of Scars / MoS**) and constant-byte associative memory (**SCache O(1)**). Every operator is verified across native PyTorch/CUDA/Metal and **34 custom client-side WebGPU WGSL 1.0 compute shaders** (`22` LLM/SCache shaders + `12` continuous 3D Optimal-Transport Flow shaders) running live at https://byte-od.github.io/.

## Core Pillars of the Scar Ecosystem

### 1. ScarNativeLM v5.0 — Tabula-Rasa Pure Scar-Native Foundation Engine
- Pretrained 100% from scratch (`step t = 0`, zero dense `nn.Linear` layers, zero pretrained Gaussian floor) directly inside the discrete scar manifold.
- **ScarNativeLinear**: Channel equilibration `d_eq` + `FWHT-64` + `D4-LUT256 VQ4-STE` + `INT4-STE` low-rank scars -> exact **`0.000000` KL divergence** upon binary shard export.
- **DifferentiableSCacheAttention**: End-to-end differentiable hybrid attention over Attention Sinks + Circular Window + Pre-RoPE Widrow-Hoff Associative Matrix `W_scar` in strict **O(1) space (`Δ = +0 B` as `T -> ∞`)**, with `cos > 0.99999` parity against WebGPU Shaders `#21` and `#22`.
- **LanguageNullspaceProjector (`P_perp_lang`) + DetachedScarStore**: Closed-form Reduced-Rank Regression (`Zero-SGD`) mints `4 KB`-aligned `INT4` cartridges in English that fire across `PT`, `EN`, `ES`, and `FR`, with `< 0.2 ms` cryptographic `0x00` GDPR physical unlearning (`Δlogits = 0.00000000`).

### 2. Mixture of Scars (MoS) & Associative SCache O(1)
- **72.7B Single-GPU Execution**: Streams all 80 layers of `Qwen2.5-72B` on a single 16 GB GPU with peak VRAM strictly `<= 2.40 GB`.
- **Constant 34.8 KB L1 SCache**: Replaces `32.77 GB` of linear `O(T)` FP16 KV Cache at `100,000` tokens (`> 99.999%` VRAM reduction, `Δ = +0 B`).
- **Live Qwen2.5-3B JARVIS Browser Engine**: `1,601.55 MiB` `Track 2.5 ProtectedInt4Scar` 36-layer model executing 100% client-side via WebGPU WGSL with `41` `HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content` conceptual cartridges routed at `Layer 23` (`P_perp_lang`) across `PT, EN, ES, FR`, plus causal-split out-of-cone epistemic guard.
- **External Benchmark**: `0.625` public score on Kaggle `Name That LLM` under `<= 2.2 GB` VRAM (`Golden-Slice MoS + Tri-Compass`).

### 3. PointScarFlow v1.0 — Continuous 3D Scar-Native Rectified Flow
- `11.85M` `ScarNativeLinear` parameters packed into a **`3.87 MiB`** (`4,057,768 B`) `D4-LUT256 VQ4-STE` shard (`zero nn.Linear`, `zero` preset 3D shape catalog).
- Integrates optimal-transport velocity field `dx/dt = v_theta(x_t, t, z_perp_lang)` for `1,024` 3D coordinates in `4` self-distilled Euler steps via **12 custom WebGPU WGSL 1.0 shaders** in **`86.45 ms`** median latency on Apple M2 (`cos > 0.99999` vs PyTorch).
- Conditioned directly on `Qwen2.5-3B Layer 23` `P_perp_lang` latents: achieves **`7.51x` Chamfer-L2 reduction** over sphere baseline (`0.0621` vs `0.4663`) and cross-lingual 3D shape cosine **`PT<->EN = 0.9978`, `ES<->EN = 0.9977`, `FR<->EN = 0.9974`**.

### 4. ScarCodec v4.0 — Domain-Independent Physical & Hardware Scar Codec
- **Radio-Astronomy RFI Excision**: Nullspace projector `P_perp` excises `1,000x` satellite bursts, recovering weak pulsar sweeps with `cos = 0.9923` at `5.75x` compression (where 2-bit VLBI collapses to `cos = 0.08`).
- **34.8 KB O(1) Aerospace Black-Box**: Retains `5/5` precursor fault signatures over `8,000+` telemetry frames in fixed `34,816 B` (`Δ = 0 B`, `cos = 0.9989`) vs `0/5` for circular ring buffers.
- **12.05x HDR CFD Shock Compression**: Entry-0 exact null vector in `LUT256` guarantees bit-exact `0.00000000` quiescent vacuum error with `O(1)` random block decoding.

### 5. AURA / System One — Origin of GradientScarMemory (34.8 KB)
- Embodied Deep RL engine where `34.8 KB` `O(1)` `GradientScarMemory` (modulated by temporal shock `Surprise = R_0 - V(s_0)`), **Frontier Ghost-Jump Scouts**, and **Tri-Compass** originated.
- `0.23 ms` P50 bare-CPU `UniversalS1Agent` solving Rubik's Cube scrambles up to Depth 10 (`232.2B` states) without MCTS search, live in-browser via ONNX Wasm SIMD.
